summary: Mint Incorporation Ltd filed a 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a non-binding MOU with Ascendze Pte. Ltd. to acquire a controlling or majority equity stake. No price, premium, or valuation terms are disclosed. The target, Ascendze, is a Singapore semiconductor/robotics firm serving Fabrinet. The board (CEO Damian Chan) supports the deal. Definitive agreements are targeted within 90 days, subject to due diligence and regulatory clearances. The MOU itself is non-binding. The 6-K maps to a US current report. Watch for binding terms, valuation, and competition/regulatory hurdles in Singapore's tech sector.
